Summary: Mid-market product team focused on product discovery + on-site search. Want to start on Hosted API to accelerate integration, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost once rerank POC is validated.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE Maya) — high level needs, interested in Redwood for reranking vs current Elastic setup.
- 2026-02-15: Product demo (recording ff_2026-02-15_5732) — showed hosted API text generation + planned rerank endpoint. Product PM: 'need deterministic relevance improvements for top-5 results'.
- 2026-02-22: Security questionnaire submitted (SOC2 + SSO required).
- 2026-03-05: Deep technical call with infra + SE (ff_2026-03-05_6109). Discovered: rerank will be applied as second-stage model to top-50 candidates from current search.
- 2026-03-09: Received request for POC acceptance criteria and sample eval set. Asked for NDCG@10, MRR, and latency P95 targets.

POC scope (agreed tentatively):
- Use Hosted API rerank endpoint for offline scoring of full eval set (50k queries) to validate model quality improvements (NDCG delta target >= +0.08).
- Run online A/B on 10% of traffic using hosted routing for 4 weeks to measure CTR / click-lift.
- If metrics stable, proposal to move to Dedicated capacity (reserved pool) for production to meet latency SLOs and predictable unit cost.

Tech/ops requirements:
- Latency target: P95 <= 150ms for rerank on 50 candidates (goal: 100-150ms typical); offline scoring throughput: ~200 qps for batch jobs.
- Model preference: open/quantized LLM variants preferred (cost conscious), but open to Redwood-verified rerank tuned models.
- Fallback policy: must support smaller/cheaper model fallback during spikes.
- Logging & eval: need detailed per-request scoring, token cost breakdown, and exportable eval artifacts (CSV of scored candidates + metrics).

Pricing/contract discussion:
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; pilot ARR target range $60k-$120k. Requested clear pilot pricing (3-month) and delta to Dedicated reserved pricing.

Risk & blockers:
- Procurement approval timeline unclear (legal + finance).
- Data residency: have EU customers; need residency guarantees before Dedicated commit.
- Engineering time: single engineer dedicated ~0.2 FTE for POC integration — may slow rollout.

Action items (open):
- SE to deliver rerank endpoint guide + sample eval pipeline (by 2026-03-16).
- AE to send pilot pricing + Dedicated reserve options (by 2026-03-16).
- Customer to upload canonical eval set (expected 2026-03-18).
